purpose: Teach: カルロス/奄美/インディアン/南アフリカ/カイロ/ジョニー/日産/西武

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがカルロスというお名前の友人のお話して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was telling me about his friend Carlos.
lines.style: Warm, affectionate tone. Gentle openness, like sharing a small delight. Relaxed pace. Eyes soft with fondness for both Sho and his father's stories.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと奄美の絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a picture book with Dad about Amami.
lines.style: Bright, eager energy. Quick to share. Slight breathiness from excitement. Looks up at Mei with the pride of having something to report. Natural child authenticity.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがインディアンの絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad reads you Indian picture books too, I hear.
lines.style: Gentle, knowing smile in the voice. Reflective—she's delighted by the pattern of his father's generosity. Slightly slower pace. The 'too' lands softly, warmly noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと南アフリカの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I looked at a South Africa picture book with Dad.
lines.style: Same bright eagerness as before. Slightly quicker energy now—he wants to keep sharing, to match Mei's interest. Small, genuine laugh quality underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがカイロのピラミッドの絵本を見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad showed you the Cairo pyramid picture book, didn't he.
lines.style: Soft, almost wistful appreciation. Slow, measured pace. The statement carries genuine wonder at the scope of his father's travels and kindness. Trailing-off at the end, lost in the image.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんがジョニーって名前の犬を飼ってたって
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad told me he used to have a dog named Johnny.
lines.style: Bright, concentrated focus—this is new information he's proud to share. Quick pace, slight lift at 'Johnny' like the name is special. Eager to see if Mei will think it's as cool as he does.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが日産の工場に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is taking you to the Nissan factory, I understand.
lines.style: Warm wonder in the voice. Gentle envy underneath—the scope of what his father offers. Slightly slower, almost tender. She's marking this milestone of connection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと西武鉄道で旅したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went on a trip with Dad on the Seibu railway line.
lines.style: Full, satisfied joy. This is the capstone memory. Slower, reflective pace—savoring the image. A small, genuine smile comes through in the voice. The closing feels warm and complete.
